edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out and punctuation is added at the source’s own phrase breaks.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文，标点依原文断句补加。

basis.en: Warring States poem from the Songs of Chu; the author is traditionally held to have died around 278 BCE.
basis.zh: 战国时期《楚辞》作品，作者传统上认为约卒于公元前 278 年。

note.en: One of the Nine Pieces of the Songs of Chu, traditionally attributed to Qu Yuan: a poem in praise of a tree that will not grow anywhere but where it was planted. The first half describes the orange; at 嗟爾幼志 the poem turns and speaks to it directly, as to a young person of firm purpose, and ends by taking it as a model. It is on this shelf because it is a poem about a will that stays.
note.zh: 《楚辞·九章》中的一篇，传为屈原所作：赞美一棵只肯生在原地的树。前半写橘，到“嗟尔幼志”一句转而直接对它说话，把它当作一位志向坚定的少年，最后以它为榜样。放在这里，是因为它写的是一种不肯迁移的意志。

excerpt.en: Bound by its nature not to move, / it grows in the southern country.

gloss.en: 后 is the earth (后土) and 皇 is heaven (皇天): the tree is a gift of heaven and earth.
gloss.zh: 后：后土，指地。皇：皇天，指天。

gloss.en: 徠 is 來, came; 服, to be suited to, at home in this soil. 兮 is a sung syllable, like ‘ah’.
gloss.zh: 徕：同“来”。服：适应（这里的水土）。兮：语气词，相当于“啊”。

gloss.en: Bound by its nature not to be moved. An old saying holds that an orange planted north of the Huai turns into the bitter trifoliate orange.
gloss.zh: 禀受天命，不可迁移。古人说橘生淮南则为橘，生于淮北则为枳。

gloss.en: 曾 is 層, layered; 剡, sharp.
蘇: awake. Clear-headed in a muddled world, and standing alone.
gloss.zh: 苏：醒觉。在浑浊的世上保持清醒，独立不移。

gloss.en: Bo Yi, a prince of the late Shang who, with his brother Shu Qi, refused to eat the grain of the conquering Zhou and starved on Mount Shouyang: the model of integrity.
gloss.zh: 商末孤竹君之子，与弟叔齐耻食周粟，饿死于首阳山，是守节的典范。
